eras.name: Xia
eras.summary: The first dynasty of the traditional histories. Archaeologists link it with the Erlitou culture of the Yi-Luo basin, but no Xia writing has been found.
eras.note: Date range is traditional; the territory shown is the Erlitou culture area.
eras.summary_zh: 传统史书中的第一个王朝。考古学家常把它和伊洛河流域的二里头文化联系在一起，但至今没有发现夏代的文字。
eras.note_zh: 起止年代采用传统说法；地图上的范围是二里头文化的分布区。

eras.name: Shang
eras.summary: A bronze-age kingdom on the Yellow River plain whose kings left the oracle bone inscriptions, the earliest Chinese writing.
eras.note: Shang territory is a hand-drawn sketch of its core area.
eras.summary_zh: 黄河下游平原上的一个青铜时代王国。商王留下了甲骨卜辞，这是已知最早的汉字。
eras.note_zh: 商的疆域是对其核心地区的手绘示意。

eras.name: Western Zhou
eras.summary: The Zhou overthrew Shang and ruled from Haojing through relatives and allies given fiefs, under the idea of the Mandate of Heaven.
eras.summary_zh: 周人推翻商朝，定都镐京，把土地分封给宗亲和盟友进行统治，并以“天命”之说为自己的统治正名。

eras.name: Spring and Autumn

snapshots.label: 770 BCE: the Zhou court moves east
snapshots.label_zh: 公元前770年：周王室东迁

snapshots.label: 680 BCE: Qin takes the Wei valley, Chu turns north
snapshots.label_zh: 公元前680年：秦人占据渭河谷地，楚国向北扩张

snapshots.label: 600 BCE: Jin and Chu, the two great powers
snapshots.label_zh: 公元前600年：晋、楚两强对峙

snapshots.label: 512 BCE: Wu destroys Xu and rises in the southeast
snapshots.label_zh: 公元前512年：吴灭徐国，在东南崛起

eras.summary: The Zhou king moved east to Luoyi and lost real power. Rival states such as Qi, Jin, Chu and Wu competed to be hegemon. Confucius lived at the end of this age.
eras.note: State borders are approximate, drawn from capitals and key cities.
eras.summary_zh: 周王东迁洛邑后，逐渐失去实权。齐、晋、楚、吴等诸侯国相互争夺霸主地位。孔子生活在这个时代的末期。
eras.note_zh: 各国边界为大致范围，依据都城和重要城邑绘制。

eras.name: Warring States

snapshots.label: 475 BCE: Yue destroys Wu, Jin is run by its ministers
snapshots.label_zh: 前475年：越国灭吴，晋国大权落入卿族之手

snapshots.label: 453 BCE: Han, Zhao and Wei divide Jin
snapshots.label_zh: 前453年：韩、赵、魏三家瓜分晋国

snapshots.label: 375 BCE: Han absorbs Zheng, Wei is the strongest state
snapshots.label_zh: 前375年：韩国灭郑，魏国最为强盛

snapshots.label: 316 BCE: Qin takes Ba and Shu, Chu takes the old Wu lands
snapshots.label_zh: 前316年：秦国夺取巴蜀，楚国占据旧吴之地

snapshots.label: 296 BCE: Zhao annexes Zhongshan and pushes north, Yan expands to Liaodong
snapshots.label_zh: 前296年：赵国灭中山、向北扩张，燕国拓地至辽东

snapshots.label: 286 BCE: Qi annexes Song
snapshots.label_zh: 前286年：齐国灭宋

snapshots.label: 278 BCE: Qin takes the Chu capital Ying
snapshots.label_zh: 前278年：秦军攻占楚都郢

snapshots.label: 260 BCE: Changping, Qin takes Shangdang
snapshots.label_zh: 前260年：长平之战，秦国夺取上党

snapshots.label: 256 BCE: Qin ends the Zhou, Chu annexes Lu
snapshots.label_zh: 前256年：秦灭周，楚灭鲁

snapshots.label: 230 BCE: Qin destroys Han
snapshots.label_zh: 前230年：秦灭韩

snapshots.label: 228 BCE: Qin takes Handan, Zhao survives only in Dai
snapshots.label_zh: 前228年：秦军攻下邯郸，赵国只剩代地一隅

snapshots.label: 225 BCE: Qin floods Daliang and ends Wei
snapshots.label_zh: 前225年：秦军引水灌大梁，魏国灭亡

snapshots.label: 223 BCE: Qin conquers Chu
snapshots.label_zh: 前223年：秦灭楚

snapshots.label: 222 BCE: Yan and Dai fall, only Qi remains
snapshots.label_zh: 前222年：燕、代相继灭亡，六国只剩齐国

eras.summary: Seven large states fought wars of conquest. Reforms made Qin the strongest, and the Hundred Schools of Thought flourished.
eras.note: State borders are approximate, drawn from capitals and key cities.
eras.summary_zh: 七个大国相互攻伐兼并。各国纷纷变法图强，秦国由此成为最强者；诸子百家也在这一时期竞相争鸣。
eras.note_zh: 各国疆界只是大致范围，依据都城和重要城市绘出。

eras.name: Qin
eras.summary: The First Emperor unified China, standardised script, coins and weights, and linked the northern walls. The dynasty fell soon after his death.
eras.summary_zh: 秦始皇统一中国，统一了文字、货币和度量衡，并把北方各国的长城连成一体。他死后没过几年，秦朝就灭亡了。

eras.name: Western Han

snapshots.label: 60 BCE: Protectorate of the Western Regions
snapshots.label_zh: 前60年：设立西域都护府

eras.summary: Liu Bang founded a dynasty that set the pattern for imperial China. Emperor Wu pushed into Central Asia and the Silk Road opened.
eras.summary_zh: 刘邦建立的汉朝为此后两千年的帝制中国定下了基本格局。汉武帝向中亚开拓，丝绸之路由此打通。

eras.name: Xin
eras.summary: Wang Mang seized the throne and tried sweeping reforms. Floods of the Yellow River and peasant revolts brought him down.
eras.summary_zh: 王莽篡夺皇位，推行了一系列激进的改革。黄河决口泛滥，各地农民纷纷起义，最终推翻了他的统治。

eras.name: Eastern Han

snapshots.label_zh: 汉朝撤出西域

snapshots.label: Ban Chao and Ban Yong restore Han control of the Western Regions
snapshots.label_zh: 班超、班勇父子先后恢复汉朝对西域的控制

snapshots.label: Han withdraws from the Western Regions
snapshots.label_zh: 汉朝撤出西域

snapshots.label: Ban Chao and Ban Yong restore Han control of the Western Regions
snapshots.label_zh: 班超、班勇父子先后恢复汉朝对西域的控制

eras.summary: The Han was restored with its capital at Luoyang. Paper was improved and Buddhism arrived, but court factions and the Yellow Turbans broke the dynasty apart.
eras.summary_zh: 汉朝在洛阳复兴，史称东汉。这一时期造纸术得到改进，佛教传入中原，但外戚与宦官轮番专权，加上黄巾起义，最终使王朝分崩离析。

eras.name: Three Kingdoms
eras.summary: Wei in the north, Shu Han in Sichuan and Wu in the south each claimed the empire.
eras.note: The lines between Wei, Shu and Wu are approximate.
eras.summary_zh: 魏据北方，蜀汉占四川，吴守江南，三国各自称帝，都自认是天下正统。
eras.note_zh: 魏、蜀、吴之间的边界只是大致示意。

eras.name: Jin

snapshots.label: 266: Sima Yan ends the Wei and founds the Jin; Wu still holds the south
snapshots.label_zh: 266年：司马炎代魏建晋，东吴仍据江南

snapshots.label: 280: Jin conquers Wu and reunites China
snapshots.label_zh: 280年：晋灭吴，天下重归一统

snapshots.label: 304: Liu Yuan founds the Han (Han Zhao) in Bingzhou; Li Xiong founds Cheng in Shu
snapshots.label_zh: 304年：刘渊在并州建汉（汉赵），李雄在蜀建成

snapshots.label: 311: Yongjia catastrophe: Han Zhao sacks Luoyang; Cheng holds most of Shu
snapshots.label_zh: 311年：永嘉之乱，汉赵攻陷洛阳；成汉据有蜀地

snapshots.label: 316: Chang'an falls; the Western Jin ends. Shi Le, still a Han Zhao general, holds Hebei
snapshots.label_zh: 316年：长安陷落，西晋灭亡；石勒（尚为汉赵将领）据有河北

snapshots.label: 317: Sima Rui rules from Jiankang (Eastern Jin); Zhang Shi holds Liangzhou (Former Liang); the Murong rule Liaodong
snapshots.label_zh: 317年：司马睿在建康建立东晋；张寔据凉州（前凉）；慕容部据辽东

snapshots.label: 319: Han Zhao splits: Liu Yao rules from Chang'an (Former Zhao), Shi Le founds the Later Zhao at Xiangguo
snapshots.label_zh: 319年：汉赵分裂，刘曜都长安（前赵），石勒在襄国建立后赵

snapshots.label: 323–325: Later Zhao takes Qingzhou and the lands between the Yellow River and the Huai
snapshots.label_zh: 323–325年：后赵夺取青州及河南、淮北之地

snapshots.label: 329: Later Zhao destroys the Former Zhao and rules the north
snapshots.label_zh: 329年：后赵灭前赵，统一北方大部

snapshots.label: 337: Murong Huang proclaims the Former Yan
snapshots.label_zh: 337年：慕容皝称燕王，建立前燕

snapshots.label: 347: Huan Wen conquers Cheng Han for the Eastern Jin
snapshots.label_zh: 347年：桓温伐蜀，东晋灭成汉

snapshots.label: 350–352: Later Zhao collapses: Ran Min's Wei rises and falls, Former Yan takes Hebei, Fu Jian founds the Former Qin at Chang'an
snapshots.label_zh: 350–352年：后赵崩溃，冉魏兴亡，前燕入主河北，苻健在长安建立前秦

snapshots.label: 358–366: Former Yan takes Bingzhou and pushes the Eastern Jin back from Henan and Luoyang
snapshots.label_zh: 358–366年：前燕取并州，又从东晋手中夺回河南与洛阳

snapshots.label: 370: Former Qin conquers the Former Yan
snapshots.label_zh: 370年：前秦灭前燕

snapshots.label: 373–376: Former Qin takes Shu and Hanzhong, then the Former Liang and Dai, and unites the north
snapshots.label_zh: 373–376年：前秦取蜀与汉中，又灭前凉和代，统一北方

snapshots.label: 383–386: After the Fei River the Former Qin breaks apart: Later Yan, Later Qin, Western Yan, Western Qin, Later Liang and the Northern Wei; Jin retakes Henan and Shu
snapshots.label_zh: 383–386年：淝水之战后前秦瓦解，后燕、后秦、西燕、西秦、后凉、北魏并起；东晋收复河南与蜀

snapshots.label: 394: Later Yan destroys the Western Yan; Later Qin finishes the Former Qin
snapshots.label_zh: 394年：后燕灭西燕，后秦灭前秦

snapshots.label: 396–400: Northern Wei overruns the Later Yan heartland; Southern Yan in Shandong; Southern Liang, Northern Liang and Western Liang split the Hexi corridor; Later Qin takes Luoyang
snapshots.label_zh: 396–400年：北魏攻占后燕腹地；南燕立国于山东；南凉、北凉、西凉分据河西；后秦夺取洛阳

snapshots.label: 403–407: Later Liang falls; Qiao Zong holds Shu; Helian Bobo founds Xia; Feng Ba takes the Later Yan throne (Northern Yan)
snapshots.label_zh: 403–407年：后凉灭亡；谯纵据蜀；赫连勃勃建夏；冯跋夺取后燕（北燕）

snapshots.label: 410–413: Liu Yu destroys the Southern Yan and retakes Shu for the Eastern Jin; Northern Liang takes Guzang
snapshots.label_zh: 410–413年：刘裕灭南燕，东晋收复蜀地；北凉夺取姑臧

snapshots.label: 417: Liu Yu takes Luoyang and Chang'an: the Later Qin falls
snapshots.label_zh: 417年：刘裕攻克洛阳、长安，后秦灭亡

snapshots.label: 418: Xia drives the Jin out of Chang'an
snapshots.label_zh: 418年：夏攻取长安，晋军退出关中

eras.summary: The Sima family reunified China in 280, but civil war and invasions drove the court south to Jiankang in 317 while the north split into the Sixteen Kingdoms.
eras.summary_zh: 司马氏于280年统一全国，但不久便陷入宗室内战和外族入侵。317年，晋室南迁建康，北方则分裂为十六国。

eras.name: Northern and Southern Dynasties

snapshots.label: 420: Liu Yu founds the Song; the north is still split among the last of the Sixteen Kingdoms
snapshots.label_zh: 420年：刘裕建立宋朝；北方仍由十六国的最后几个政权分据

snapshots.label: 439: Northern Wei has conquered Xia, Northern Yan and Northern Liang, uniting the north
snapshots.label_zh: 439年：北魏先后灭夏、北燕和北凉，统一北方

snapshots.label: 466–469: Northern Wei takes Shandong and the land north of the Huai from Song
snapshots.label_zh: 466–469年：北魏从刘宋手中夺取山东和淮北

snapshots.label: 479: Xiao Daocheng founds the Southern Qi in place of Song
snapshots.label_zh: 479年：萧道成代宋建立南齐

snapshots.label: 502: Xiao Yan founds the Liang; Northern Wei has taken Nanyang, Shouchun and soon Hanzhong
snapshots.label_zh: 502年：萧衍建立梁朝；北魏已夺取南阳、寿春，不久又取汉中

snapshots.label: 534: Northern Wei splits into Eastern Wei (at Ye) and Western Wei (at Chang'an)
snapshots.label_zh: 534年：北魏分裂为东魏（都邺城）和西魏（都长安）

snapshots.label: 550: Northern Qi replaces Eastern Wei; during Hou Jing's revolt it takes the land between the Huai and the Yangtze
snapshots.label_zh: 550年：北齐取代东魏，并趁侯景之乱夺取江淮之间的土地

snapshots.label: 553–555: Western Wei takes Sichuan and sacks Jiangling, leaving the Western Liang as its puppet
snapshots.label_zh: 553–555年：西魏攻取蜀地，攻陷江陵，扶立西梁为傀儡

snapshots.label: 557: Chen Baxian founds the Chen; Yuwen Jue founds the Northern Zhou
snapshots.label_zh: 557年：陈霸先建立陈朝；宇文觉建立北周

snapshots.label: 573: Chen's northern expedition retakes the land between the Huai and the Yangtze
snapshots.label_zh: 573年：陈朝北伐，收复江淮之间的土地

snapshots.label: 577: Northern Zhou conquers Northern Qi and reunites the north
snapshots.label_zh: 577年：北周灭北齐，重新统一北方

snapshots.label: 578–579: Northern Zhou takes the land north of the Yangtze from Chen
snapshots.label_zh: 578–579年：北周从陈朝手中夺取长江以北的土地

eras.summary: A north ruled by Xianbei dynasties such as the Northern Wei faced a series of southern dynasties at Jiankang. Buddhism spread across both.
eras.summary_zh: 北方由北魏等鲜卑人建立的王朝统治，南方则在建康相继更替了几个王朝，南北长期对峙。佛教在南北两地都广为流传。

eras.name: Sui

snapshots.label: 581: Yang Jian founds the Sui; Chen and the Western Liang client state remain
snapshots.label_zh: 581年：杨坚建隋，南方陈朝与附庸西梁仍在

snapshots.label: 587: Sui abolishes the Western Liang
snapshots.label_zh: 587年：隋废西梁

snapshots.label: 589: Sui conquers Chen and reunites China
snapshots.label_zh: 589年：隋灭陈，南北统一

eras.summary: A short-lived dynasty that reunified north and south after nearly three centuries of division, and dug the Grand Canal.
eras.summary_zh: 一个短命的王朝，却结束了南北近三百年的分裂，重新统一了中国，还开凿了大运河。

eras.name: Tang

snapshots.label: 640 onward: Anxi and Beiting Protectorates
snapshots.label_zh: 640年起：设立安西、北庭都护府

snapshots.label: After 755: the protectorates hold out, cut off by Tibet
snapshots.label_zh: 755年后：西域都护府仍在坚守，但被吐蕃隔断

snapshots.label: 790 onward: the Western Regions are lost
snapshots.label_zh: 790年起：西域尽失

eras.summary: A cosmopolitan empire reaching into Central Asia along the Silk Road. The An Lushan rebellion of 755 broke central power, and Tibet took the Hexi Corridor.
eras.summary_zh: 一个开放包容的大帝国，势力沿丝绸之路深入中亚。755年爆发的安史之乱摧毁了中央权威，吐蕃趁机夺取了河西走廊。

eras.name: Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms

snapshots.label: 907: Zhu Wen ends the Tang and founds the Later Liang; regional governors become kings
snapshots.label_zh: 907年：朱温灭唐建立后梁，各地节度使纷纷称王

snapshots.label: 913: Jin conquers Yan and takes Youzhou
snapshots.label_zh: 913年：晋灭燕，夺取幽州

snapshots.label: 915–916: Jin wins Weibo and the north bank of the Yellow River; Former Shu takes Qi's western prefectures; Abaoji proclaims the Khitan state
snapshots.label_zh: 915–916年：晋夺取魏博和黄河以北地区；前蜀夺取岐国西部诸州；阿保机建立契丹国

snapshots.label: 923: Li Cunxu founds the Later Tang and destroys the Later Liang; Qi submits the next year
snapshots.label_zh: 923年：李存勖建立后唐，灭后梁；次年岐国归附

snapshots.label: 925: Later Tang conquers Former Shu; the Khitan destroy Balhae in 926
snapshots.label_zh: 925年：后唐灭前蜀；926年契丹灭渤海

snapshots.label: 934: Meng Zhixiang founds the Later Shu in Sichuan
snapshots.label_zh: 934年：孟知祥在四川建立后蜀

snapshots.label: 936: Shi Jingtang founds the Later Jin and hands the Sixteen Prefectures to the Khitan; Dali replaces Nanzhao in 937
snapshots.label_zh: 936年：石敬瑭建立后晋，把燕云十六州割给契丹；937年大理取代南诏

snapshots.label: 937: Li Bian founds the Southern Tang in place of Wu
snapshots.label_zh: 937年：李昪取代吴国，建立南唐

snapshots.label: 939: After the Bach Dang victory, Ngo Quyen rules Annam as an independent king
snapshots.label_zh: 939年：白藤江大捷后，吴权在安南称王自立

snapshots.label: 947: The Khitan sack Kaifeng and rename their state Liao; Liu Zhiyuan founds the Later Han; Min has been divided between Southern Tang and Wuyue
snapshots.label_zh: 947年：契丹攻破开封，改国号为辽；刘知远建立后汉；闽国已被南唐和吴越瓜分

snapshots.label: 951: Guo Wei founds the Later Zhou and the Liu family holds out as Northern Han; Southern Tang destroys Chu and Southern Han takes its Guangxi lands
snapshots.label_zh: 951年：郭威建立后周，刘氏退守太原建立北汉；南唐灭楚，南汉夺取楚国在广西的土地

snapshots.label: 952: Hunan rises and drives out Southern Tang; the Wuping Circuit rules it
snapshots.label_zh: 952年：湖南军民起兵赶走南唐，由武平军统治

snapshots.label: 955–958: Later Zhou takes four prefectures from Later Shu and all Southern Tang land north of the Yangtze
snapshots.label_zh: 955–958年：后周夺取后蜀四州及南唐在长江以北的全部土地

snapshots.label: 959: Chai Rong retakes Ying and Mo prefectures from the Liao, then dies
snapshots.label_zh: 959年：柴荣从辽朝收复瀛、莫二州，随后病逝

eras.summary: Five short dynasties followed each other in the north while ten kingdoms ruled the south. The Khitan Liao took the Sixteen Prefectures around modern Beijing.
eras.summary_zh: 北方五个短命王朝相继更替，南方则有十个政权割据一方。契丹建立的辽朝夺取了今北京周围的燕云十六州。

eras.name: Northern Song

snapshots.label: 960: Zhao Kuangyin's Chenqiao mutiny ends the Later Zhou; the Song takes over its land
snapshots.label_zh: 960年：赵匡胤陈桥兵变，取代后周，建立北宋

snapshots.label: 963: Song troops take Jingnan and Hunan (Wuping) in one campaign
snapshots.label_zh: 963年：宋军假道灭荆南，又平定湖南武平

snapshots.label: 965: Later Shu surrenders; Meng Chang is taken to Kaifeng
snapshots.label_zh: 965年：后蜀投降，孟昶被押往开封

snapshots.label: 971: Song conquers Southern Han; Đinh Bộ Lĩnh has unified Jiaozhi
snapshots.label_zh: 971年：宋灭南汉；交趾已由丁部领统一

snapshots.label: 975: Jinling falls; Li Yu of Southern Tang surrenders
snapshots.label_zh: 975年：金陵城破，南唐后主李煜出降

snapshots.label: 978: Wuyue and the Quan–Zhang circuit hand their land to the Song
snapshots.label_zh: 978年：吴越钱俶、漳泉陈洪进纳土归宋

snapshots.label: 979: Northern Han falls; the Song has reunited China proper
snapshots.label_zh: 979年：北汉灭亡，宋统一中原与南方

eras.summary: A civil dynasty run by examination graduates, with a booming commercial economy, printing and paper money, facing the Liao and Western Xia.
eras.summary_zh: 一个由科举出身的文官治理的王朝，商业经济繁荣，印刷术和纸币广泛使用，北面和西北面分别与辽和西夏对峙。

eras.name: Southern Song
eras.summary: After the Jurchen Jin took Kaifeng, the Song court ruled the south from Lin'an (Hangzhou), the richest city in the world.
eras.note: The Song border along the Huai River is approximate.
eras.summary_zh: 金军攻陷开封后，宋室南渡，以临安（今杭州）为都城统治南方。当时的临安是世界上最富庶的城市。
eras.note_zh: 图中宋金沿淮河的边界为大致示意。

eras.name: Yuan
eras.summary: Kublai Khan founded a Mongol dynasty with its capital at Dadu (Beijing) and conquered the Southern Song in 1279. Tibet was governed through the Xuanzheng Yuan; Xinjiang mostly belonged to the Chagatai Khanate.
eras.summary_zh: 忽必烈建立蒙古人统治的元朝，定都大都（今北京），1279年灭南宋。吐蕃由宣政院管辖，新疆大部分属于察合台汗国。

eras.name: Ming

snapshots.label: 1616: Nurhaci founds the Later Jin
snapshots.label_zh: 1616年：努尔哈赤建立后金

snapshots.label: 1621: Later Jin takes Liaodong
snapshots.label_zh: 1621年：后金攻取辽东

snapshots.label: 1636: Hong Taiji renames his state Qing
snapshots.label_zh: 1636年：皇太极改国号为清

eras.summary: Zhu Yuanzhang drove out the Mongols. The Ming rebuilt the Great Wall, sent Zheng He's fleets across the Indian Ocean and built the Forbidden City.
eras.note: Ming ties with Tibet (乌思藏) ran through titles and tribute. Whether Tibet was part of the Ming is debated, so it is drawn outside.
eras.summary_zh: 朱元璋推翻蒙古人的统治，建立明朝。明朝重修长城，派郑和率船队远航印度洋，还修建了紫禁城。
eras.note_zh: 明朝与西藏（乌思藏）的关系主要通过封授名号和朝贡维系。西藏是否属于明朝版图，学界尚有争论，因此图中画在明朝疆域之外。

eras.name: Qing

snapshots.label: 1644: Li Zicheng takes Beijing, then the Qing drive him out; Southern Ming rules from Nanjing; Zhang Xianzhong's Great Xi in Sichuan
snapshots.label_zh: 1644年：李自成攻入北京，清军入关将其逐出；南明弘光帝在南京即位；张献忠在四川建大西

snapshots.label: 1645: Qing armies take Xi'an and Nanjing; the Hongguang court falls; the Longwu emperor rules from Fuzhou and the Prince of Lu from Shaoxing
snapshots.label_zh: 1645年：清军攻占西安、南京，弘光政权覆灭；隆武帝在福州即位，鲁王在绍兴监国

snapshots.label: 1646: Qing take Zhejiang and Fujian; the Longwu emperor is killed; Zhang Xianzhong dies; the Yongli emperor is enthroned at Zhaoqing
snapshots.label_zh: 1646年：清军取浙江、福建，隆武帝遇害；张献忠战死；永历帝在肇庆即位

snapshots.label: 1647: Qing take Guangdong and Hunan; Great Xi forces under Sun Kewang move into Guizhou and Yunnan; Zheng Chenggong holds Xiamen for the Ming
snapshots.label_zh: 1647年：清军取广东、湖南；孙可望率大西军进入贵州、云南；郑成功据厦门奉明正朔

snapshots.label: 1648: Li Chengdong in Guangdong and Jin Shenghuan in Jiangxi go over to the Yongli emperor; Ming forces retake Hunan
snapshots.label_zh: 1648年：李成栋在广东、金声桓在江西反正归明；明军收复湖南

snapshots.label: 1649–1650: Qing retake Jiangxi and Hunan, then Guangzhou and Guilin
snapshots.label_zh: 1649–1650年：清军收复江西、湖南，又攻陷广州、桂林

snapshots.label: 1652: Sun Kewang brings the Yongli emperor to Guizhou; Li Dingguo retakes Guilin and southern Hunan
snapshots.label_zh: 1652年：孙可望迎永历帝入贵州；李定国收复桂林及湖南南部

snapshots.label: 1655: Qing retake Guangxi and southern Hunan; the Ming holds Yunnan and Guizhou
snapshots.label_zh: 1655年：清军夺回广西和湖南南部，南明退守云贵

snapshots.label: 1658–1659: Qing take Guizhou and Kunming; the Yongli emperor flees to Burma
snapshots.label_zh: 1658–1659年：清军攻取贵州、昆明，永历帝逃入缅甸

snapshots.label: 1662: The Yongli emperor is put to death in Kunming; Zheng Chenggong drives the Dutch from Taiwan
snapshots.label_zh: 1662年：永历帝在昆明被杀；郑成功驱逐荷兰人，收复台湾

snapshots.label: 1663–1664: Qing take Xiamen and Kinmen; the Zheng hold only Taiwan
snapshots.label_zh: 1663–1664年：清军攻取厦门、金门，郑氏仅保台湾

snapshots.label: 1673–1674: Revolt of the Three Feudatories: Wu Sangui rises in Yunnan and takes Guizhou, Sichuan, Hunan and Guangxi; Geng Jingzhong rises in Fujian; the Zheng return to the coast
snapshots.label_zh: 1673–1674年：三藩之乱：吴三桂起兵云南，占贵州、四川、湖南、广西；耿精忠在福建响应；郑经重返沿海

snapshots.label: 1676: Geng Jingzhong surrenders; Shang Zhixin rises in Guangdong
snapshots.label_zh: 1676年：耿精忠投降；尚之信在广东响应吴三桂

snapshots.label: 1677–1678: Shang Zhixin surrenders; Wu Sangui proclaims himself emperor of Zhou at Hengzhou and dies
snapshots.label_zh: 1677–1678年：尚之信投降；吴三桂在衡州称帝，国号周，随即病死

snapshots.label: 1679–1680: Qing retake Hunan, Guangxi and Sichuan; the Zheng lose Xiamen
snapshots.label_zh: 1679–1680年：清军收复湖南、广西、四川；郑氏丢失厦门

snapshots.label: 1681: Kunming falls and Wu Shifan dies; the revolt is over
snapshots.label_zh: 1681年：昆明城破，吴世璠自杀，三藩之乱平定

snapshots.label: 1683: Taiwan and Mongolia join the Qing
snapshots.label_zh: 1683年：台湾和蒙古归入清朝

snapshots.label: 1720: Qing troops enter Lhasa
snapshots.label_zh: 1720年：清军进入拉萨

snapshots.label: 1759: Qing conquers Xinjiang
snapshots.label_zh: 1759年：清朝平定新疆

snapshots.label: 1860 onward: territory lost to Russia
snapshots.label_zh: 1860年以后：领土被沙俄割占

eras.summary: The Manchu Qing built the largest Chinese empire, then faced rebellion and Western and Japanese imperialism. It ended with the abdication of the last emperor in 1912.
eras.summary_zh: 满洲人建立的清朝缔造了疆域最大的中华帝国，后来却饱受内乱和西方列强、日本的侵略。1912年末代皇帝退位，清朝灭亡。
